messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: prom-scrape-job-failed (P1) on cluster us-west-2. alert link: https://pagerduty.com/services/REDWOOD-METRICS/incidents/ID12345. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/prom-scrape. Symptoms: >50% scrape failures, high scrape durations, and backlog in log-ingest topic.

Alex G: Acked. I'm pulling logs from the prometheus-scrape deployment now.

Maria C: Noted. Seeing gaps on the metrics dashboard (service_latency, request_count) starting ~18:22 UTC. Customer-facing dashboards show missing series for several services.

Samir R: `kubectl get pods -n metrics` shows many `prom-scrape-exporter-` pods in CrashLoopBackOff. Quick logs show repeated OOMKill and "killed process". Also seeing `connection reset by peer` for some scrape targets.

Alex G: Trying a soft-restart of the scrape replicas to get them out of the crash loop. Command: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/prometheus-scrape -n metrics``` Doing that now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert escalated to infra-oncall after 2min no-ack by primary.

Pat (oncall): I'm taking over from here. Pat oncall-handoff -> Alex G, Samir R are with me. Maria, can you draft a Status page update?

Maria C: On it. Drafting: "We are investigating increased Prometheus scrape failures and delayed log ingestion affecting metrics dashboards. Engineers are restarting scrape jobs and scaling ingestion consumers. No data loss expected; some alerts may be delayed. Updates every 15 minutes." Will post in 5.

Samir R: After restart, pods come up but memory usage spikes to ~1.6Gi consistently. Looks like an exporter memory leak on long scrape lists. Increasing replicas won't help long-term but will absorb load: `kubectl scale deployment prometheus-scrape --replicas=6 -n metrics`. Also spinning up extra Kafka consumers on the log-ingest consumer group: `kubectl scale deployment/log-consumer -n ingest --replicas=10`.

Alex G: Applied scales. HPA applied as temporary mitigation: ```apiVersion: autoscaling/v2beta2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: prom-scrape-hpa
  namespace: metrics
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    kind: Deployment
    name: prometheus-scrape
  minReplicas: 3
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: memory
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 70
```

Maria C: Status page posted: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/12345 (note to comms: no ETA yet).

Samir R: Observability update: Kafka lag for log-ingest consumer group peaked at ~1.2M msgs but is decreasing after scaling. Prom scrape failures rate dropped from 78% -> 12% in the last 6 minutes. Some services still missing metrics due to target timeout; working through rebalancing.

Pat (oncall): Good. Any customer-facing incidents to escalate to support? Which tenants are affected?

Maria C: Quick scan shows high-impact on internal dashboards and a subset of customers in us-west who rely on exporter-level metrics. I'm creating a support ticket and will ping CS with the list.

Alex G: Rolling a patched exporter image (memory-fix branch) to a small canary set: ```kubectl set image deployment/prometheus-scrape prom-scrape=ghcr.io/redwood/prom-scrape:fix/mem-2026 -n metrics``` Canary looks stable for 4m, no OOMs. Planning gradual rollout if no regressions.

Samir R: Also trimmed scrape timeout from 30s -> 15s for noisy targets to reduce backlog: `kubectl apply -f prometheus-scrape-configmap.yaml -n metrics` (changed `scrape_timeout: 15s`). That recovered a bunch of stuck connections.

Pat (oncall): PagerDuty: manual acknowledgement recorded by Pat at 18:36 UTC. Leaving the incident open while we validate full recovery and finish customer comms.

Maria C: Support notified, status page updated again: "We have mitigations in place; metrics ingestion is returning to normal. We will follow up with a post-incident report and next steps."

Alex G: After rolling the canary and updating timeouts, scrape success rate is ~98%, Kafka lag returned to near zero. Still keeping extra replicas for the next 2 hours.

Samir R: Creating followup tickets: 1) backfill automation for missed metrics series 2) permanent fix for exporter memory leak and update to test coverage 3) refine scrape job sizing and HPA rules.

Pat (oncall): Nice work. Closing notes: Severity P1 => customer-impacting dashboards degraded but no permanent data loss. Owners: Samir (fix), Alex (deploy pipeline + rollback plan), Maria (status & comms). We'll run a short postmortem tomorrow. If nothing regresses, I'll resolve PD incident in 30m. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident resolved by Pat at 18:47 UTC. Resolution note: temporary scale + timeouts + exporter patch reduced failures. Permanent fix ticket created: TICK-5678.

Alex G: Adding a quick playbook blurb to runbook about this exporter leak and the HPA temp mitigation.

Maria C: Thanks team. I'll post the postmortem stub after the oncall sync.

Samir R: Leaving a record for runbook: steps to scale, restart, canary roll, and how to backfill missed metrics.

Pat (oncall): Handoff complete. Reassigning to owners and closing the Slack thread."
